name: rcore_app
description: Frappe App Shell for Rcore Core Platform

modules.name: base
modules._comment: Added during composer schema migration: corporate/polaris/frappe's Loan and LoanTransfer doctypes have Link fields with options="Branch", and Branch is only defined in this module (moved on disk to core/base/frappe from the retired core/core). Without composing it, polaris's doctype links would fail to resolve. manifest.json's own 'name' and its 137 hardcoded '{app_name}.core....' hook path segments were rewritten to 'base' in the same commit as this rename, so the module 'name' here and the manifest's identity now agree.

modules.name: lms
modules._comment: Supacharge's home SDK (LMS domain: lessons, schedule, partner links). Moved here from paas/composer.json (2026-07-24) so lms is always present for every tenant via rcore, same as brain, gated by a subscription flag instead of by paas-plan eligibility — a tenant on a non-paas plan no longer loses lms access.

modules.name: replay
modules._comment: Supacharge's session-replay SDK (Replay Session schedule + decision #8 release-asset pipeline: fetch/cache/serve, warm + evict). Composed beside lms, which its serving gates resolve into.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Full frappe/payments port (Payment Gateway + Braintree/GoCardless/Mpesa/Paymob/PayPal/Paytm/Razorpay/Stripe settings) plus Rokct's own PayFast/Paystack gateways and paystack_checkout page, which moved here from pay's payments/frappe when the 'pay' module entry was retired. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone payments app - a site must NOT have Frappenize/payments installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names are intentionally identical and would double-define (same rule as the crm entry below).

modules.name: erp
modules._comment: ERPNext v16 fork flattened into one composed module (fork of frappe/erpnext via Frappenize/erpnext@rokct-hotfix); upstream crm/projects/support are excluded and resolve to the productivity repo's SDK modules. Composed here because the 'projects' entry below REQUIRES it (projects/frappe/manifest.json: Task extends the ERPNext Task doctype and imports erp helpers; erp calls back into {app_name}.projects.*) and compose_backend.py composes exactly the listed modules with no dependency pull-in - compose both or neither. A site composed with this module must NOT also have upstream erpnext installed. Pinned at the pay head alongside wallet/gateways (one ref per source repo: the composer clones each git URL once, at the first listed entry's ref); strict-compose verified at this SHA.

modules.name: builder
modules._comment: Replaces the 'dev' entry (../corporate/dev/frappe): corporate/builder/frappe is the same Flutter build pipeline composed under its contract paths ({app_name}.builder.tasks._generate_flutter_app, {app_name}/builder/source_code). The two entries cannot coexist - both ship the flutter_app_configuration / flutter_build_settings doctypes and the composer hard-fails on duplicate DocTypes.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, deals, contacts, organizations, notes, tasks, call logs, statuses) ported from Frappenize/crm (frappe/crm fork) into the productivity SDK. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone frappe/crm app — a site must NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names (CRM Lead, CRM Deal, ...) are intentionally identical and would double-define. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.

modules.name: projects
modules._comment: Server home of the productivity_sdk Tasks screen: the six api.projects.* gateway cmds (sync_personal_task, list_personal_tasks, snooze_task_reminder, delete_personal_task, propose_task_breakdown, apply_task_breakdown) plus the Task reminder cron. Tasks are local-first on every device and sync whenever this backend is reachable, so every tenant that serves an app composing productivity_sdk composes this module the same way. Requires the erp entry above; the erp-tenant-tree import fix (productivity#32) is needed for the pair to install. Pinned at the productivity head that carries that fix, alongside productivity/crm (one ref per source repo).
